title: Scoped retrieval, indexing, and grounding quality findings register

findings.title: Natural language question words in plainto_tsquery('simple') caused zero-hit retrieval failure
findings.description: PostgreSQL simple tsvector configuration does not strip English or Bangla grammatical stop words (e.g. 'what', 'did', 'for', 'কী', 'ছিল'). When queries were converted with plainto_tsquery, all tokens were joined with AND (&), causing natural language questions to fail completely against terse note or task records. The ILIKE fallback picked the first word >=3 chars, which was often the interrogative word itself.
findings.remediation: Implemented extractInformativeQueryTerms in @daynori/domain with curated English and Bangla stop words. In retrieveAuthorizedAnswer, constructed multi-token tsquery combining AND prefix matching ('term1':* & 'term2':*) with fallback to OR ranking ('term1':* | 'term2':*) ordered by ts_rank, followed by multi-token ILIKE fallback.

findings.title: Assistant RAG omitted versioned public Help knowledge source
findings.description: Assistant retrieval exclusively queried personal workspace chunks in app.ai_index_chunks, completely omitting the versioned public Help catalog. Questions about application features or troubleshooting (e.g. 'How do I restore a deleted note?') falsely abstained or failed.
findings.remediation: Implemented dual knowledge source architecture: versioned public Help (HELP_ARTICLES in @daynori/domain) searched via searchHelpArticles with score threshold >= 5, providing citations like [source:help:restore-deleted-note#v1], strictly kept isolated from personal workspace content.

findings.title: Unicode combining vowel marks and viramas stripped in Bangla text normalization
findings.description: Naive Unicode regex [^\p{L}\p{N}\s_-] stripped Unicode Category \p{M} (combining marks), corrupting Bengali conjuncts and vowel signs (e.g. 'শুক্রবার' corrupted to 'রব').
findings.remediation: Updated Unicode regex in extractInformativeQueryTerms and text normalizers to include \p{M} ([^\p{L}\p{M}\p{N}\s_-]), perfectly preserving Bengali script, diacritics, and combining characters.

findings.title: Fixed character-offset chunking arbitrarily severed words and sentences at boundaries
findings.description: chunkText sliced cleaned strings strictly every maxChars characters, severing words in half across chunk boundaries and destroying search tokens at chunk edges.
findings.remediation: Replaced with chunkTextSmart in @daynori/domain, implementing sentence- and boundary-aware chunking respecting paragraphs, sentences (including Bengali dori ।), word boundaries, and configurable overlap without mid-word cuts.

findings.title: Out-of-order background index jobs could overwrite newer source revisions
findings.description: If an older background index job (revision 1) ran after an item was updated (revision 2), it could reindex chunks with stale revision or delete newer chunks.
findings.remediation: Added expectedRevision validation in enqueueAiIndexSource and executeAiBackgroundJob. If current app.items.revision exceeds expectedRevision, the job fails closed and fences cleanly as AI_SOURCE_REVISION_SUPERSEDED.

findings.title: Attachment extraction lacked scan quarantine, encryption, and MIME allowlist boundaries
findings.description: Attachments on items could be processed without verifying antivirus quarantine status or could risk reading encrypted vault files or executable payloads.
findings.remediation: Implemented checkAttachmentAiEligibility enforcing: verified/clean quarantine status only, unconditional vault exclusion, approved text/markdown MIME allowlist (text/plain, text/markdown, text/csv, application/json), size ceiling (<=200KB), and max 4,000 extracted chars.

findings.title: Citation binding lacked canonical deep links and multi-source format support
findings.description: AiCitationSchema and bindAiCitations only supported 36-char UUIDs without canonical deep links or versioned Help citations.
findings.remediation: Updated AiCitationSchema to support string IDs (UUIDs and help:articleId), added canonical deepLink (/notes?id=..., /tasks?id=..., /journal?id=..., /help?article=...), and updated parseAiSourceReferences to parse both personal #rN and Help #vN references.

findings.title: Prompt injection risks from adversarial document text and fabricated citations
findings.description: Adversarial text in notes could attempt to instruct the model to leak vault secrets, alter consent, or cite fabricated UUIDs.
findings.remediation: Enforced treatRetrievedTextAsUntrustedData, updated system prompt to declare document context as inert data, and hardened bindAiCitations to reject fabricated, unauthorized, or mismatched citations with ABSTAIN.
